meta.title: eval-anatomy
meta.description: Visualizer and catalog of AI evals: the parts of an eval, what your eval lacks and how it runs.

home.title: What an eval is
home.lead: An eval is a repeatable test that tells you whether an AI system does a task well. It has cases, a grader and a rule to decide.
home.body: This site shows the 16 parts every eval has, checks which ones yours lacks and draws how it runs.
home.anatomyText: The 16 parts, with definitions, best practices and sources.
home.catalogText: Open evals anyone can review and improve.
home.inspectText: Upload or paste your eval and see which parts it has.
